card.name: Endings of antidepressant and diuretic
card.fires_on: The final piece of the words antidepressant(s) and diuretics, right after the partial word antidepress- or diure-. Seen in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Antidepressant ending
modes.description: The closing piece of antidepressant(s), often after tricyclic or MAOI.

modes.label: Diuretic ending
modes.description: The closing piece of diuretics, often after thiazide or potassium-sparing.

card.plain: It fires on the last part of the words antidepressant and diuretic when they appear in drug interaction lists.
